preparation: A separately approved binding/grant and unchanged complete inventory must pass before exclusive run-root/profile preparation. Existing roots and all failed attempts are retained, never reused or deleted.
entry: empty_client.py with the exact prepared active_binding.json path
transport: isolated SDK stdio only; fixed command, source, cwd and explicit overrides; no shared URL or global registration
sdk_environment: Explicit pinned site-packages/win32/win32-lib paths and scoped pywin32_system32 DLL search; no .pth execution. SDK default safe variables may also be inherited by the parent; target roles receive the explicit six-field environment.
native_target_controls: Preserved owned worker/watchdog/job controls and 60/80/90/95/100/110/120-second contract; not measured here.
failure_policy: Stop on authority, startup, protocol, marker, nonzero-dimension or closure error. Preserve reservation, logs and failure receipt. No second selection after a first-call error and no automatic retry.
native_role_launch: Bound base python.exe for worker/watchdog only; SDK stdio client keeps the venv executable.
saved_exit_reader: termination_evidence.read_exit_witness(run_root, expected_scope, required_roles); strict new-version receipts, no legacy fallback or native acceptance claim.
cache_evidence: Actual five-field client, adapter, worker and watchdog proofs; exact reservation and empty terminal prefix. No saved MAC authentication claim.
saved_cache_reader: termination_evidence.read_cache_witnesses(run_root,expected_scope,binding); strict new source only; no native or independent authentication acceptance.
